subject: general
question: Some features of alveoli are mentioned below. Select the INCORRECT option.

options.text: Have extensive network of blood vessels

solution:
The correct answer is __**are finger-like structures**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Alveoli **have an extensive network of blood vessels** which facilitates gas exchange.
 
• They are **thin-walled** to allow easy diffusion of gases.
 
• Alveoli possess a **large surface area** to maximize the efficiency of gas exchange.
 
• The structure of alveoli is **not finger-like**; instead, they are more **sac-like or balloon-shaped**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The alveoli are the primary sites of **gas exchange in the lungs**, where **oxygen is absorbed into the blood**, and **carbon dioxide is expelled**.
 
• The thin walls of the alveoli are composed of a single layer of epithelial cells and a thin basement membrane, which aids in the rapid exchange of gases.
 
• The large surface area of the alveoli is due to the presence of numerous alveolar sacs, each containing many alveoli, providing a vast surface for gas exchange.
 
• Surfactant, a substance produced by alveolar cells, reduces surface tension within the alveoli, preventing their collapse and ensuring they remain open for gas exchange.
